description: Find cancer genes and fusions in CIViC by name or symbol, with how much curated clinical evidence each carries (variant count, evidence-item count, assertion count). AUTHORITATIVE starting point for "what does CIViC know about gene X" — CIViC is the open expert-curated knowledgebase of clinically actionable somatic cancer variants. Returns the numeric CIViC feature id you pass to the other tools.
name: civic_search_genes
title: Civic Search Genes
